text:
mike-devex: Heads up — after yesterday's OpenAPI regen the python client is retrying POSTs without the Idempotency-Key header and we got a billing double-charge report from a customer.
anya-eng: whoa, only python? TS/Go clients behaved?
sam-sre: customer repro attached in the ticket — they call /v1/charges with client v1.14.0 (regen) and see 200 then a retry that returns 201.
julia-qa: i ran a quick local repro: 
```bash
# using python client 1.14.0
resp = client.charges.create(...)
# network flake -> client retries
```
and logs show retry path doesn't include headers['Idempotency-Key'] before the second attempt.
anya-eng: that's consistent with the generated retry wrapper — looks like header propagation moved to the lower-level request builder in the TS/Go templates but python's regen kept it at the request callsite and our retry decorator reconstructs the request without copying custom headers.
billing-oncall: customer reported a ~$500 duplicate charge. billing team flagged as P1. Need triage notes and mitigation.
ci-bot: CI job #build-openapi-regen-2339 failed (client-unit tests) — flaky tests rerouted to golang client, pass.
mike-devex: quick mitigation: propose adding a server-side guard (idempotency-key dedup window) but we need a client patch ASAP. Can we patch python regen to hoist headers into the retry function?
anya-eng: yes, patch is small. i'll open PR with tests mimicking a transient 502 and assert header present on retry. also adding a changelog note about header semantics.
sam-sre: can we hotfix a pinned wheel release for customers on 1.14.x while regen goes through review?
julia-qa: i can write a small integration test against staging that simulates broken network and asserts single server-side charge. will run after PR.
mike-devex: also, bisect CI — which openapi diff introduced the header relocation? anyone have the spec diff?
anya-eng: found diff: in components -> requestBodies the x-client-headers field moved under content.application/json -> schema. i'm guessing the generator mapped that to callsite headers. attaching snippet: 
```diff
- x-client-headers: ["Idempotency-Key"]
+ content:
+   application/json:
+     schema:
+       x-client-headers: ["Idempotency-Key"]
```
mike-devex: great catch. that explains template mapping change. we'll treat as a generator edge-case and add a template test to prevent future regressions.
billing-oncall: customers on 1.14.0 — do we have a list? we should notify and advise pin to 1.13.x or apply patch.
sam-sre: i'll open a support advisory draft with mitigation steps and a snippet to set header manually in the mean time: 
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.default_headers['Idempotency-Key'] = my_key
```
mike-devex: thanks. action items: anya PR + test, sam advisory, julia integration run, ci-bot to add generator regression test. mark as P0 until hotfix published. :warning:
ci-bot: created issue #regen-client-header-propagation-2340 and added to milestone "regen-fixes-urgent"
anya-eng: i'll aim to get PR up in the next 2 hours.
mike-devex: 👍 keep updates here and drop postmortem once resolved.
